what: When the pointer is over a name tag (data-cursor), a blob of accent color 10% of the screen width, holding that text, turns on in .3s. On every 1/120s tick the blob chases the mouse by 1/5 of the remaining distance (20px above the cursor), and the text tilts by the remaining horizontal distance/5, so fast movement spins the text. If the tag is a link, pressing it turns the text off and only the blob spreads 20x in 1s until it covers the screen (the transition text turns on .3s later over .3s), then fx:flood fires and the page goes to that address.

options.follow: Chase share denominator (1/n of the remaining distance per tick), default 5
options.lift: Px lifted above the cursor, default 20
options.fade: On/off duration (sec) · delay for the handoff text, default .3
options.--fx-size·--fx-disc·--fx-on: Bubble diameter (default 10vw) · bubble fill · text color
options.[data-cursor]: The element that triggers the blob and its text. If a, it spreads on press
options.[data-fx-part=flood-text]: (If any) swipe text that lights up in the center as it spreads

note: The original spread with a CSS transition (scale 1s ease) and Swup 3 waited for its end before swapping the body. So the part works without a transition library, it changes the address after spreading with GSAP — when handing off to Swup or barba, call preventDefault in fx:flood and call their navigate. On devices that can’t hover (hover false), nothing is attached and the link goes through as is.
